posts.text: The moment you stop masking, you start healing.
ADHD diagnosis in adulthood is like seeing the map after years of wandering.
The ADHD tax: buying planners you’ll never open.
ADHD is waking up ready to conquer the world and ending the day wondering why taking a shower took you out
ADHD isn’t random—it’s imagination without restraint. You feel this too? Anyone else?
Living with ADHD treats every idea like an emergency so I learned to design around my brain.
